content: Compare matching metrics from several panels side by side without rebuilding each view.
Select a death to inspect the incoming damage, healing, and auras immediately before it.
Use the ledger view to compare consumable usage and estimated cost across players.
Scan cooldown usage raid-wide to find missing uses and gaps in planned coverage.
The rotation timeline makes idle gaps and out-of-order casts visible second by second.
Pair the map with Replay to follow movement, positioning, and targets through the fight.
Check logger versions and recorded metadata here when a raid is missing expected events.
Review pull boundaries and cleanup events when encounter segmentation looks unusual.
